name: Octagon Commodities Quote Skill to Google Sheets - Template Ready

parameters.content:
## Octagon Commodities Quote Skill to Google Sheets

### What this workflow does

This workflow reads commodity symbols from Google Sheets, uses the live `commodities-quote` Skill to build a precise Octagon Agent prompt, retrieves real-time commodity quote data, parses all returned fields, and writes the structured results back to the same row.

### Required Google Sheet setup

1. Duplicate your commodities quote Google Sheet template before running the workflow: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vLTwTsx3vHgYOKpYh7Lz6l3ImokIPN6jUKNQm0L1K-M/edit?usp=sharing

2. Keep the first tab named `Sheet1`, or update both Google Sheets nodes to the correct tab.
3. The sheet must include a `Symbol` column. This is the matching column used for row updates.
4. Add these columns exactly as written:

`Ticker`, `Current Price`, `Change`, `Volume`, `Day Range`, `52-Week Range`, `Exchange`, `Previous Close`, `Date`, `Octagon Response`

### Example input rows

| Symbol | Commodity |
|---|---|
| GCUSD | Gold |
| SIUSD | Silver |
| CLUSD | Crude Oil WTI |
| NGUSD | Natural Gas |

### n8n setup checklist

- [ ] Duplicate the Google Sheet template.
- [ ] In **Read Commodity Symbols in Sheets**, select the duplicated spreadsheet and the correct sheet tab.
- [ ] In **Update Commodities in Sheets**, select the same duplicated spreadsheet and sheet tab.
- [ ] Confirm `Symbol` is selected as the matching column in the update node.
- [ ] Configure Google Sheets OAuth credentials.
- [ ] Configure OpenAI credentials for prompt generation.
- [ ] Configure Octagon credentials for the quote lookup.

## Manual commodities run

Starts the template manually. Use this for testing after you duplicate the Google Sheet and connect both Sheets nodes to that duplicate.

## Configure commodities skill

Sets the commodities quote task and fetches the live `commodities-quote` Skill from GitHub. The prompt builder uses this Skill context for each row.

## Read duplicated Sheet

Reads commodity rows from the duplicated Google Sheet. Required input column: `Symbol`. Optional helper column: `Commodity`. Make sure this node points to the same spreadsheet and tab as the update node.

## Generate and execute quote prompts

Loops over each commodity symbol, asks GPT-5.4 Mini to build a focused Octagon Agent prompt from the Skill, then sends that prompt to Octagon Agent.

## Parse and update all fields

Parses JSON, markdown tables, or plain-text Octagon responses into every supported quote column, updates the matching `Symbol` row, and waits briefly before the next symbol.

For every row, return structured fields for Symbol, Commodity, Current Price, Change, Day Low, Day High, Day Range, Year Low, Year High, 52-Week Range, Trading Volume, Previous Close, 50-Day Average, 200-Day Average, Exchange, Date or Quote Time, and Source/Status so the Google Sheets update node can populate every configured column.
